docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
cuPQC is a CUDA-based SDK that provides GPU-accelerated building blocks for modern cryptography.

cuPQC is designed to serve as a GPU-accelerated foundation for higher-level cryptographic implementations, whether embedded as a backend in existing libraries or used to build new, GPU-native components and applications. It focuses on accelerating performance-critical computations rather than providing complete end-to-end protocol stacks, so applications and libraries can compose these building blocks into full schemes and systems.

For developers, cuPQC SDK Developer Hub provides a practical integration path with clear APIs, example code, and benchmarks to help validate correctness and measure performance.

cuPQC SDK release announcements, version highlights, and changelogs.

cuPQC v0.4 August 21, 2025 Improve Data Integrity and Security with Accelerated Hash Functions and Merkle Trees

Expanded hash function support (SHA-2, SHA-3, SHAKE, Poseidon 2) and comprehensive Merkle tree calculations. Enables efficient data integrity verification, membership proofs, zero-knowledge proofs, and hash-based signatures with GPU acceleration.

Read Blog Post → cuPQC v0.2 December 3, 2024 Introducing NVIDIA cuPQC for GPU-Accelerated Post-Quantum Cryptography

Initial release introducing GPU-accelerated NIST-approved PQC operations including ML-KEM and ML-DSA. Achieves breakthrough performance with 13.3 million key generations per second for ML-KEM-768 on H100 GPU. Comprehensive side-channel security reviews ensure robust protection.
